Belo Horizonte Drivers Lose 130 Hours Per Year in Traffic, TomTom Traffic Index 2025

2026-08-13 Rafaela Mendes TomTom Traffic Index, Belo Horizonte, Brazil, traffic congestion, urban mobility, TomTom, traffic data
Read the source article

Quick summary

Belo Horizonte ranks 33rd globally in the TomTom Traffic Index 2025 with 58.6% congestion, surpassing São Paulo as drivers lose 130 hours per year — over 5 full days — stuck in traffic.

Key takeaways

  • Belo Horizonte drivers lost 130 hours in traffic during 2025, equivalent to over 5 full days
  • BH ranks 33rd globally with 58.6% congestion, edging out São Paulo at 58.5%
  • Among Brazilian capitals, BH is 3rd alongside Recife (130 hours), behind Curitiba (135h) and São Paulo (132h)
  • Worst days are Tuesdays and Wednesdays, with morning congestion reaching 97% and evening peaking at 103%
  • Data presented at the NTU Seminar by CNT using TomTom Traffic Index figures
  • The TomTom Traffic Index monitors congestion in hundreds of cities with over 800,000 inhabitants
